# Expressive Voice 2.5

Installs as an update over 2.0 and the betas (same package name and signing key).

## New
- **Live recording notification** — while you record, a notification shows a running timer with **Pause/Resume** and **Stop** buttons. On Android 16 it is marked as a live update, so it can appear as a status-bar chip and on the lock screen.
- **Recording keeps going in the background** — pressing Home or switching apps no longer risks cutting the recording off.
- **Notification permission** — on Android 13+ the app asks once; recording works even if you say no.

## Changed
- Back arrow / back button while recording now stops and saves the recording, same as Stop.
- If a recording is already running, the home screen's Record button takes you back to it instead of starting another.
- Contact email in About, Terms and Privacy updated.

## Fixed
- **Check for updates** no longer shows "Error checking for updates" (the app was missing the internet permission).
